src.title: 6 Low-Calorie Air Fryer Recipes You Can't Say 'NO' To...

recipes.title: Air Fryer Buffalo Chicken Chalupas

items.i: chicken breasts, patted dry and flattened (amount estimated)
part-skim mozzarella and 2% Colby Jack, shredded

steps: Season
Pat the chicken dry, flatten it, and press ⅓ packet of ranch dip seasoning into both sides. Spray with avocado oil.
Air fry chicken
Air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 9–10 minutes until cooked through, then dice.
Sauce
Blend the Greek yogurt, cottage cheese and Frank's RedHot until smooth, then toss with the diced chicken.
Build
Lay a pita flat, add mozzarella and Colby Jack, the buffalo chicken and more cheese, then fold tightly.
Crisp
Spray both sides with avocado oil and air fry at 400°F for about 4 minutes until crispy.
Serve
Open slightly and stuff with lettuce and tomato.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros per chalupa are from the creator. The chicken amount and number of chalupas (4) are estimates.

recipes.title: Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Tenders with Garlic Parmesan Sauce

items.i: egg whites mixed with a splash of buffalo sauce
seasoning: sea salt, black pepper, onion powder, chilli powder
each black pepper, red pepper flakes, oregano and basil

steps: Roast garlic
Wrap the garlic bulbs loosely in foil and bake at 400°F for 40–50 minutes until soft.
Stations
Set up three bowls: flour; egg whites with buffalo sauce; panko mixed with the seasoning.
Coat
Dredge each tender in flour, dip in the egg wash, then press into the panko (one dry hand, one wet hand keeps it tidy).
Air fry
Spray both sides with cooking spray and air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 9 minutes until crispy.
Sauce
Squeeze out the roasted garlic and mix (or blend) with the yogurt, vinegar, Parmesan, sweetener, red peppers, lemon juice and seasonings.
Serve
Dip the tenders in the sauce.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros (75 cal, 11 g protein per tender) are from the creator. The whole sauce batch is 212 cal and 7 g protein. Chicken, flour and egg white amounts are estimates.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crunchy Taco Pockets

items.i: chicken broth, plus a splash more

steps: Filling
Brown the beef, then add the taco seasoning and chicken broth. Stir in the Mexican cheese, Laughing Cow wedges and nutritional yeast until thick but not dry (add more broth if needed).
Glue
Mix the flour with a little water into a paste.
Shape
Cut each tortilla in half. Fold one side over, glue under the fold and press to make a cone.
Fill & seal
Spoon in filling, press it down, glue the top edge, fold shut and crimp with a fork. Repeat for all 10.
Air fry
Spray with cooking spray and air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 4–5 minutes until golden.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros per pocket (10 total) are from the creator. The cheese amount is an estimate.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Jalapeño Popper Chicken Hot Pockets

items.i: chicken tenders, seasoned with ranch dip mix

steps: Chicken
Season the chicken tenders with ranch dip mix, cook them through, then chop finely.
Jalapeños
Air fry the jalapeños at 400°F for 5–7 minutes, then remove the seeds and dice.
Filling
Mix the Greek yogurt, Laughing Cow wedges, roasted jalapeños and ¼ packet ranch, then fold in the chicken, cheese, black beans, corn and pico.
Assemble

Brush the edges of a bread slice with egg white, add filling, top with a second slice brushed with egg white, press and crimp with a fork, then trim the crusts. Makes 4 (you'll have filling left over).
Air fry
Air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 4–5 minutes until golden.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros per hot pocket are from the creator. Jalapeño count, cheese and pico amounts are estimates.

recipes.title: Thick Cornflake-Crusted McChicken

items.i: garlic powder, black pepper, salt and paprika

steps: Patties
Mix the ground chicken with the mustard and seasonings and form 3 even balls.
Coating
Blend the corn flakes with garlic powder and paprika into crumbs and tip into a shallow bowl.
Coat
Press each ball into the crumbs and flatten into a thick patty.
Air fry
Air fry at 400°F / 200°C for 10–12 minutes, flipping halfway.
Assemble
Serve in buns with shredded lettuce and light mayo.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros per sandwich (3 total) are from the creator.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Brownie Protein Pizookie

items.i: chocolate chips, melted, plus a few for the top
protein ice cream (e.g. Oreo protein Creami)

steps: Dry
Mix the protein powder, cocoa, flour, baking soda and salt so there are no clumps.
Wet
Add the syrup, egg, pumpkin (you won't taste it) and melted chocolate chips and mix into a thick brownie batter.
Pan
Spread into a 6½-inch cast-iron pan and scatter a few more chocolate chips on top.
Air fry
Air fry at 300°F / 150°C for about 6 minutes; it should stay fudgy in the middle.
Serve
Top with scoops of protein ice cream and eat warm.
recipes.notes: Amounts from the on-screen captions; macros (whole pizookie) are from the creator and likely exclude the ice cream.
